rawFindings.title: Fix incorrect condition in _applyPaths method
rawFindings.explanation: The change at line 517 removes a necessary check '!~keys.indexOf(path)' when condition 'exclude === false' and there are multiple keys. This could cause the query to incorrectly apply default schema path selections when the key is already specified, potentially resulting in unexpected field inclusion or exclusion in query results.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the condition to: if (false === exclude && keys.length > 1 && !~keys.indexOf(path)) to ensure selective application of field inclusion/exclusion based on user specified keys.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: A query selecting multiple fields including explicitly specified keys may incorrectly include/exclude additional fields due to the missing check.
